items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And then he was playing trumpet. At the time Johnny McDonald was playing trumpet but he had to quit... And a few others. ... there's Johnny New Rob. He plays the trumpet and trombone and sings.

ctx.x: That's good in case they have any trouble. Yeah, they do.

Either that or jump over with one or two. Yeah. Been up there a long time with Johnny McDone. We used to call ourselves the Melody Man. We just spot around. We had a nice set up there. Good old band. And then after the band broke up, and then we started to play over at, let's see, at the Legends Dance Hall, that one, Charles and Mary. All they have is four men there. That's Bill Mayo. That's a guitar player? Yeah, the guitar player. Yeah, the guitar player. And let's see, Johnny, Johnny, he commented on drums.…
